g.text: Start (0, 0, -750). Ten directions tilted in the x-z plane with impact parameter b = 750·sin(α).
Shader constants: kRs=100, kStepMin=1, kStepMax=35, kMaxRadius=2000. Integration stops at capture (r<Rs) or escape (r>kMaxRadius).
The blue dashed circle marks b_crit = 3√3/2 · Rs ≈ 259.81 — rays with b<b_crit are captured; rays with b>b_crit escape.
